reviews.text: Great
Very friendly, very nice
Great staff and people who genuinely care about animals. Very helpful

I can’t say enough wonderful things about this veterinary practice. Yesterday, I was able to catch a very sick stray kitten and immediately called to see if they could help. Without hesitation, they told me to bring the kitten in.

They treated this little kitten with such compassion and care, and I was incredibly grateful that they were willing to help when she needed it most. Even more impressive, the cost of his treatment was extremely fair and reasonable.

It means so much to know there is a veterinary practice that cares not only about their patients, but also about helping animals in need. I’m so grateful for their kindness, professionalism, and generosity. I highly recommend them!

I can’t stress how AMAZING DR. BORROTO and West Kendall Animal Hospital and staff are!  This place is truly UNIQUE! Everyone at West Kendall Animal Hospital is there for the Love of your animals. They are Human and not money driven. This is THE MOST IMPORTANT thing to look for when choosing a Vet and its staff to look after your precious pets. I am Humbly GRATEFUL for the way they cared of my 15 year old fur baby LadyBug! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND DR.BORROTO & WEST KENDALL ANIMAL HOSPITAL ♥️💋🐾🐶🐾💋♥️

Had to change my rating 7/2026, 5 stars ***BUT here we are 9/14/2026, 1 star, so my appt was at 11:30am got there around 11:34am for my cat because she had a scratch above her eye, front desk lady was helping someone so not to interrupt we took a seat about 5 mins later she asked us if we had an appt we said yes 11:30am so she proceeds to help the lady than a few moments later she goes to the back then some guy comes out now it’s around 1145 and tells us that they’re going to lunch at 12pm that if we can come back which we told him we drove 35 minutes to get here if you guys cannot see patient because you’re going to lunch then don’t make appts for 11:30 which then he told us but you got here late, which we told him 4mins is not that late & it’s not my fault your front desk receptionist didn’t ask us when we walked in if we had an appt & waiting about 5 mins to ask us & then waited to go to the back to tell him that we was there, which then he tells us if we can wait in the car till 1pm, that was so **unprofessional** thats not how u treat your patients. We will never go there again….
Everyone here is amazing and great with my pets!

I don't remember the names of the young guy that took care of my dog more the lady doctor. They were pleasant, made sure I was comfortable, asked many times if I had concerns about my dog, was very communicative. The doctor was also good.

Our family will forever be grateful for Dr. Gutierrez. Earlier this year, Dr. Gutierrez diagnosed our fur baby with a tumor and counseled us on what our course of treatment should be. At all times, she remained in continuous contact with us, she followed our fur baby’s progress through surgery and continues today (months later) during chemotherapy treatment. Her genuine concern and care has been invaluable to us.  We consider her our fur baby’s Guardian Angel! Thank You Dr. Gutierrez from Pebbles and family!

The last experience we had at this office was not good to say the least…but they’ve leveled up! They went from having rude staff to staff who was welcoming, accommodating and happy to help. I’m glad we gave them a chance for redemption because they did not disappoint. Pandora will be coming back!
Excellent service!! I recommend it

The staff is so patient and caring, and the environment is always clean and welcoming. You can truly tell how much they love pets! 🐾

This was my second visit, and I can confidently say I’ve found my forever vet for my kitties! ❤️ Thank you all so much for making every visit such a great experience.

The front desk staff was wonderful and friendly, the nurses were amazing, and of course, Dr. Natalie Gutierrez was incredibly knowledgeable, kind, and friendly. I’m so grateful to have found such a wonderful team to care for my fur babies! 🐱💕
Great staff, great doctor, careful and thorough consideration in a kindly environment.  Can't ask for more or better.

Caring and professional staff, convenient hours, and years of experience combine to make West Kendall Animal Hospital a great place for my kitties -- and your furbabies -- to get the quality health care they deserve. For a mani/pedi, full exam, or TLC when they're sick, you can count on WKAH's doctors and techs.
Unfortunately Dr Jeffrey left the facility ....let's see now with a new veterinarian.
Dr. Gutierrez is so caring and have plenty of knowledge. Julia at the front desk is very helpful and friendly

We have had a great experience with our cat, she was due for her injection and Sarah made sure she wouldn’t freak out. Dr. Borroto saw our cat, she was very nice. Every time we’ve gone there they are very kind. They are very friendly.

We’ve had such a great experience with West Kendall Animal Hospital. They have been so thorough and caring with my mom’s dog Leo, who was diagnosed with diabetes. They’re always on top of his care, checking in on him, and making sure his health is being managed the right way. They also recently took care of my dog Luna for surgery and dental work and I felt really comfortable knowing she was in good hands. The staff has been kind, attentive, and patient with both of our dogs, and you can tell they truly care about the animals they treat. We’re really grateful for everything they’ve done for Leo and Luna, and I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a vet clinic they can trust.

I discovered this vet about a year ago when my cat got a tumor and they have just been incredibly kind. Throughout the whole process they have been so friendly and caring for my cat. Very thankful to this entire team, highly recommend. A shout out to Violet, Angel, Julia and Dr. Gutierrez for all the amazing care of Cutie!
Everyone in this hospital has been so kind and helpful! Dr. Burroto is very knowledgeable and answered all my questions about my kitten. 10/10 experience

Love Dr. Gutierrez! She breaks everything down do clearly, so easy to understand!  The entire staff is amazing, warm, and welcoming!  This office has always taken excellent care of our fur babies over the years ... if I could give it 10 stars, I would!!

This place has been amazing with my furry babies. I love the way staff cares about every pet that enters their facility. I recently had my cat spray and the experience was great. My baby is recovering pretty fast and no sign of pain so far. 10/10 rotten tomatoes haha

They stuck five needles to draw blood, and in the end, I had to tell them to stop. They did the fecal exam, and they almost pulled the stick down his throat. Wow. Amazing service! Got home to my dog limping and in obvious pain and needed to get her seen asap. Her normal vet was not able to squeeze me in. So I called west Kendall animal hospital. They also were booked but did everything possible to squeeze us in. They even took care of getting old medical records and everything. The staff is caring and professional. At the end of the day gave me great new that my cocoa wouldn’t need surgery, just meds and rest. Pretty sure I’ll be switching vets soon. Recommend 100%. Thank you.

I had a great experience taking my cat here for his first round of vaccines, everyone in the team did a fantastic job taking care of him, making sure he felt comfortable and safe. They explained everything to me in great detail, they were patient and open to all my questions and concerns. Overall we couldn’t be more thankful for the service and happy that we picked West Kendall Animal Hospital. Stanley says “thank you for the tuna treat”. 🐈

never again. i had to reschedule my appointment almost two times just to do an annual for my cat because the only doctor kept calling out. we all have lives and responsibilities. rescheduling all the time isn’t something we all can be available for… I lost my patience at this point and asked if there was another option I can go to. they recommended i went to the country walk animal hospital  instead. best offer. going there from now on. The receptionist was very nice and considerate of everything which  I appreciated. but be wary of rescheduling because of the doctor if you’re wanting to make an appointment at this hospital.
